text.body:
ātmaprakṣālaṇārthāya snānakṛtyam ihocyate |
śaucācāravidhānena śasyate lokato yataḥ || [8.1]
kalpitaṃ snānakaṃ karma bhedena tan nigadyate |
kavacakrodhayogātmā trikṣarādi(?) diśo daśa || [8.2]
sarvānarthaprahānāya vajrayakṣaṃ prabhāveyet |
krodhaṃ vighnāntakaṃ caiva svātmānaṃ krodharūpakam || [8.3]
oṃ kili 2 vajra hūṃ phaṭ |
anena mantrayet |
oṃ ṭuḥ kavacaḥ hūṃ |
oṃ hūṃ vajrayakṣa |
oṃ amṛtakuṇḍali phaṭ |
amṛtakuṇḍaleḥ |
ātmānaṃ bhāvayed ghoraṃ vajrajvālāsuduḥsaham |
anena vajramantreṇa vajrajvālena mudrayā || [8.4]
oṃ dhupi 2 kāyadhupini svāhā |
phalāvatāraṇārthāya vārṣya (?) 'ñjalitrayaṃ kṣipet |
mantreṇānena japtvā tu daṃṣṭrābhayamahānaye || [8.5]
sarvabuddhakulaṃ yac ca vidyā yābhimatam (?) |
adhiṣṭhāya ca mantreṇa mṛttikāputtalītrayam || [8.6]
ūrdhvādhomadhyabhāgaṃ ca tanmudrā mrakṣayet tanum |
vāmaṃ dakṣiṇahastena savyaṃ vāmena buddhimān |
tac cābhinayayogena ūrdhvādikramataḥ punaḥ || [8.7]
asya mantraḥ | oṃ jvale svāhā ||
sarvamudrājalotkṣepāt sarvavighnā nimantritāḥ |
sarvabuddham anusmṛtya rahasyaṃ vidyayā mataḥ || [8.8]
diśāṃ bandhaṃ tv anenaiva śakraṃ ca pūrvabhāgataḥ |
dakṣiṇe ca yamo rājā paścime varuṇo bhavet || [8.9]
dhanadaś cottare caiva catuḥputtalikā mṛdā |
diśordhvaṃ vāyasaṃgṛhya ūrdhvārdhe puttalīdvayam || [8.10]
vidikṣu ca tathā kṛtvā vighnabandhaḥ kṛto bhavet |
vajramuṣṭisudīptā ca vajralocanamudrayā || [8.11]
vajrajvālānalārkena vighnabandhaḥ kṛto bhavet |
tataḥ snātvā praṇāmaṃ ca caturdikṣu mahātmabhiḥ || [8.12]
caturṣu ca caturmudrā yogena pīṭham aṣṭakam |
kuryāt kaṭimuṣṭiṃ ca akṣobhyasya tu pañcamī || [8.13]
vidikṣu bhramaṇenaiva tataḥ stotraṃ ca nāmanām |
vajrācāryo mahābhāgo rahasyaṃ paramottamam || [8.14]
evaṃ kṛtvā tu nirvidhāt (?) pūjātritayaṃ sṛjet |
pratipattyā tu pūjaiva kartavyā cāryasattamaiḥ || [8.15]
homaś cāpi kathaṃ kāryaṃ tvaṃ deveha nigadyate |
kāyikaṃ trividhaṃ karma vacasā tu caturvidham || [8.16]
mānasaṃ triprakāraṃ ca kuryād dhomaṃ hi muttamam |
evaṃvidhavidhānena sarvapuṇyamayo bhavet || [8.17]
snānavidhiḥ || ||
